cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plan cost more, so you announce the budget cut. That was the bargain. I taught you to deliver bad figures as clearly as good ones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give them the small figure accurately. You've stopped rounding everything in your favour; keep that improvement when you speak to them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why I taught you. Read your first sentence to me now; I'll correct it once, then you make the announcement. I won't take your place at the front.

reason: Ground the exact paired behavior in remembered pupil habits and a specific immediate ask. Complete all three measurement/gain/rank dimensions where required, and keep unrevealed stakes visibly withheld rather than inventing them.
